The Azad Maidan Dispute

A brief six-hour film shoot at Mumbai's historic Azad Maidan escalated into a public disagreement involving the Mumbai Cricket Association and the creators of the upcoming zombie thriller Pralay. Producer Hansal Mehta defended the production's paperwork while addressing broader concerns regarding the difficulties of filming in the city.

The production house Light Rays utilized 5,000 square yards of the ground after paying a booking fee and a security deposit, erecting large sets and laying artificial grass for the sequence.

Government Permission and Cricket Disruptions

The Maharashtra government's Sports Department granted clearance for the shoot, which caused the postponement of Under-14 and Under-16 inter-school cricket matches. Navnath Fartade, Deputy Director of Sports for the Mumbai Division, defended the approval by citing a resolution that permits non-sporting events at the venue for up to thirty days annually.

The approval documents were signed by Sports Department Under Secretary Ashok Damayyawar, with the production fulfilling financial requirements including deposits and fees under specified conditions.

The Mumbai Cricket Association's Objections

The Mumbai Cricket Association expressed strong opposition, stating they were not consulted before the authorization was issued for a ground dedicated to youth training and tournaments. Nadim Memon, an MCA Apex Council member, highlighted that the ground is already impacted by Aqua Line Metro construction and police occupancy, arguing that commercial film shoots should not displace young athletes.

The association raised concerns about the precedent this sets, fearing that further commercial bookings could permanently diminish available open spaces for aspiring cricketers in the city.

Hansal Mehta's Defense and Criticism

Hansal Mehta asserted that the production possessed every required clearance, including permissions from police and sports departments alongside an acknowledgement from the MCA. Speaking to the Hindustan Times, he voiced deep frustration with the bureaucratic friction filmmakers face in Mumbai.

Mehta remarked that despite holding valid paperwork, film crews are frequently treated as trespassers, adding that various departments possess individual powers to halt productions unexpectedly.

Broader Industry Implications

Mehta contrasted Mumbai's regulatory hurdles with other states that actively welcome film crews with streamlined processes and economic incentives. He noted that the cumulative difficulties in obtaining clearances are driving producers to shoot outside of Mumbai, threatening the city's status as the heart of Indian cinema.

The conflict underscores a larger friction between maintaining authentic local backdrops for stories and navigating complex municipal and state regulations for public spaces.

About the Production Pralay

Pralay is a post-apocalyptic zombie thriller with a reported budget of 300 crore rupees, set in a near-future Mumbai affected by a pandemic and a subsequent outbreak. The project stars Ranveer Singh and marks the Hindi film debut of Kalyani Priyadarshan.

The film is directed by Jai Mehta in his feature debut, with a script written by Jai Mehta and Vishal Kapoor. Production is backed by True Story Films, Maa Kasam Films, and Birla Studios, with principal photography commencing in August 2026.

News Overview

A film shoot for Pralay at Azad Maidan disrupted youth cricket matches and triggered a public debate involving the Mumbai Cricket Association, the state sports department, and producer Hansal Mehta. While the production secured official government permits, the controversy highlighted ongoing bureaucratic challenges and location constraints for filmmakers in Mumbai.

Introduction to the New Preview

Mubi has officially launched a second preview for the forthcoming Belgian World War I drama titled Coward. This fresh footage arrives ahead of the movie's theatrical rollout in select US cinemas during the upcoming holiday season.

The project marks the third feature film from acclaimed Belgian director Lukas Dhont, following his previously celebrated works.

Festival Circuit and Critical Reception

Before its upcoming commercial distribution, the picture initially debuted at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, where it managed to secure numerous positive notices from critics. Following its Cannes premiere, it continued its run at several other major international gatherings including the Toronto, Hamburg, and Melbourne festivals.

Reviewers have widely praised its emotional depth, calling it a striking exploration of tenderness and devotion amidst global conflict.

Plot and Setting

Set against the brutal backdrop of World War I near the Belgian trenches, the narrative follows a deeply intimate journey of youthful self-discovery. It examines the fragile boundary between fear and bravery for soldiers seeking glory.

The central question raised by the story is whether choosing love over brutality during wartime represents the ultimate act of courage.

Key Characters and Performances

The movie stars breakthrough performers Emmanuel Macchia as Pierre alongside Valentin Campagne as Francis. Pierre enters the front lines as a naive young soldier trying to adapt to a violent reality until he encounters a kindred spirit.

Francis introduces Pierre to the idea of staging a front-line theatre show, providing a sanctuary of innocence amidst the devastation of the trenches and anchoring the narrative with their strong on-screen chemistry.

Behind the Camera

Lukas Dhont serves as the director for this feature, having previously helmed projects such as Girl and Close. He co-wrote the screenplay alongside Angelo Tijssens.

The production team includes producer Michiel Dhont, cinematographer Frank van den Eeden, and composer Valentin Hadjadj, who crafted the original musical score.

Release Details

Mubi has scheduled the theatrical rollout to begin in limited US cinemas starting on December 25th, 2026. Audiences worldwide will soon have the chance to experience the historical drama on the big screen.

The newly revealed promotional video can currently be accessed directly through Mubi's official YouTube channel.

The film follows a wartime romance between two soldiers portrayed by Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne after premiering earlier at the Cannes Film Festival.

The popular reality television show Bigg Boss 20 recently witnessed a deeply emotional turning point during its latest family task. Contestants were given a chance to reconnect with their loved ones, bringing forth raw and touching moments inside the house.

ld.articleBody:
Passing of a Veteran Director

The acclaimed Hungarian-British film and television director Peter Medak has passed away at the age of 88. His family announced that he died peacefully on Tuesday, October 27, in Los Angeles. While a specific cause of death was not disclosed, his passing marks the end of a prolific career spanning six decades across feature films, television, and the arts.

Throughout his extensive working life, Medak earned a reputation as a dedicated filmmaker whose credits ranged from cult classics to widely recognized critical successes. His death leaves behind a rich legacy in both cinema and television production, noted by colleagues and family members alike.

Early Life and Upbringing in Budapest

Born in Budapest, Hungary, in 1937, Medak discovered an early fascination with motion pictures at just eight years old when an aunt gifted him a 35-millimeter hand-cranked projector along with a strip of film. However, his formative years were heavily marked by political turmoil under the Communist regime.

When he was 13 years old, he was banned from attending school because his father was labeled a capitalist and imprisoned for years. With his mother working in a plastics factory and his brother having passed away, Medak spent long stretches alone, observing the world from their apartment window, an experience he later credited with shaping his observant perspective.

Escape to England and Career Beginnings

In 1956, at the age of 18, Medak fled to England. He began his professional journey as a trainee at Associated British-Pathe, gaining hands-on experience on major British production sets before quickly advancing to assistant director roles on projects such as The Great Armored Car Swindle and The Phantom of the Opera.

His early industry contributions soon caught the attention of MCA Universal Pictures. In 1963, the studio brought him to Los Angeles under a television-directing contract, where he worked on series like Court Martial, laying the groundwork for his future in American television.

Feature Films and Critical Acclaim

Paramount signed Medak in 1967 to helm his debut feature, Negatives, starring Glenda Jackson. He followed this with two celebrated black comedies in 1972: A Day in the Death of Joe Egg, starring Alan Bates, and The Ruling Class, featuring Peter O'Toole. The latter earned Medak a nomination for the Palme d'Or, while O'Toole received an Academy Award nomination.

Over the course of his career, Medak directed 27 feature films, gaining renown as an actors' director. His notable filmography includes The Changeling starring George C. Scott, The Krays featuring Martin and Gary Kemp, Let Him Have It, and Romeo Is Bleeding with Gary Oldman.

Television Work and Music Ventures

In addition to his feature work, Medak maintained a prolific career in television directing, accumulating 59 episodic credits. His television portfolio included acclaimed and influential series such as Homicide: Life on the Street, Chicago Hope, The Wire, and Breaking Bad.

Beyond traditional film and television, Medak possessed a deep passion for music. He directed some of the earliest music videos for prominent artists like Peter Gabriel and Pink Floyd, and applied his vision to the opera realm by directing La voix humaine with Julia Migenes, staging Salome in Minneapolis, and working on Rigoletto with the Los Angeles Opera.

Documentary Success and Personal Philosophy

In 2018, Medak released the documentary The Ghost of Peter Sellers, which earned critical acclaim and won Best Documentary at the Beverly Hills Film Festival. His enduring dedication to the craft was encapsulated in his own reflection on filmmaking: "If it's in your blood, directing... you never stop directing and it doesn't matter that you're alone in your mind, dreaming or imagining things but you're always making a movie."

Medak is survived by his children Christopher, Joshua, Karen, and Cornelia Medak, as well as his grandchildren Sacha, Marlowe, Ryden, Oliver, and Anders. He was previously married to Katherine La Kermance, Carolyn Seymour, and Julia Migenes, and was in a relationship with Christine Wagner.

Renowned film and television director Peter Medak has died at the age of 88 in Los Angeles. With a career spanning six decades, he directed 27 feature films and numerous television episodes, leaving behind a lasting legacy in the entertainment industry.

Introduction to a Fresh On-Screen Pairing

The pairing of television actors Gaurav Khanna and Shraddha Arya in the Star Plus series Dil Ki Bewafaiyaan has quickly become a prominent talking point among daily soap viewers. Marking their very first project working together, the two lead actors step into the roles of Manav and Janaki, a married couple who navigate the complex layers of love, expectations, and emotional distance in their relationship.

Backed by producer Ektaa Kapoor, the romantic family drama has successfully found strong traction across social media platforms. Audiences frequently share and discuss viral clips highlighting the duo's playful exchanges and warm domestic moments within the narrative.

Exploring Midlife Companionship on Television

A major part of the show's growing appeal stems from its exploration of a familiar yet relatively less explored space within the landscape of Indian television. Rather than focusing entirely on young romance, the narrative centers on midlife companionship.

Viewers are drawn to the realistic depiction of the different ways mature individuals understand happiness, compromise, and fulfillment within the institution of marriage.

Gaurav Khanna Reveals a Fun Set Secret

While the lead actors regularly handle heavy, emotionally charged dramatic sequences in front of the camera, Gaurav Khanna recently shared a lighter, humorous detail from their working environment.

Speaking candidly about his working equation with his co-star, Gaurav noted that Shraddha possesses a youthful spirit, stating that she has a child inside her and remains a child at heart.

Catered Treats for Better Performances

Elaborating further on how he manages this playful energy during long shooting schedules, Gaurav explained that he sometimes has to cater to the inner child of his co-star to help her deliver optimal results.

He remarked that feeding her specific evening snacks—such as chips and baked or fried items that she genuinely enjoys—helps set the right mood so that she can perform her best scenes effortlessly.

Enhancing Natural On-Screen Chemistry

This lighthearted behind-the-scenes revelation has added a warm, endearing layer to the show's rising popularity among dedicated fans and television critics alike.

For the audience members closely following the turbulent yet endearing journey of Manav and Janaki, the easy comfort and camaraderie shared between Gaurav and Shraddha off the camera clearly contribute to making their on-screen chemistry feel much more natural and believable.

Introduction to Quiztopia

Netflix has officially revealed the promotional video for its upcoming Japanese dystopian sci-fi thriller series titled Quiztopia. The project brings the pages of a well-known manga to life in a live-action format.

The television series is based specifically on the manga Kokumin Kuizu, which was created by authors Reiichi Sugimoto and Shinkichi Kato.

The Alternate World Premise

The story is set within an alternate version of Japan where a government-sanctioned television quiz show holds supreme authority over the nation. Under a newly established law, participants who manage to win the competition are granted any wish they desire by the government.

The stakes are remarkably high, as winning wishes can range from attaining immense wealth and fame to committing murder, erasing criminal records, founding entirely independent nations, or even taking private ownership of public landmarks.

Viewership and Penalties

The live broadcasts of these high-stakes quiz competitions command staggeringly high ratings among the public. Society eagerly consumes the broadcasts as casual entertainment within this cheerful dystopia.

However, the consequences for failure are extremely harsh. Contestants who lose the competition face severe penalties, including harsh forced labor.

The Host and the Resistance

At the center of the broadcast is KK, the wildly popular and charismatic host of the program portrayed by actor Takayuki Yamada. His life takes a sharp turn during the narrative.

KK crosses paths with a dedicated group of dissidents who threaten to bring an end to the program. This faction aims to dismantle the show's iron grip on the population and spark a revolutionary event.

Extensive Ensemble Cast

The series features a massive ensemble cast alongside the lead actor. Performers rounding out the cast include Riko Ishida, Kana Kurashina, and Koji Seto.

Additional appearances are made by Rin Kataoka, Yuzu Aoki, Naruki Matsukawa, Yuki Imai, Shunsuke Daitoh, Kou Maehara, Hoshino Disco, First Summer Uika, Keiko Horiuchi, Toshinori Omi, Masahiro Takashima, Eiko Koike, and Renji Ishibashi.

Release Details

Fans waiting to see how the revolution unfolds will not have to wait much longer. The streaming platform has scheduled the series release for later this year.

Quiztopia officially arrives on Netflix on December 17th.

The Search for Infinity Castle Part 2 Release Details

Following the phenomenal theatrical success of the first film, audiences around the world have been eagerly searching for any official updates concerning the next chapter of the saga. Infinity Castle firmly established its dominance by landing a spot in the global top ten highest-grossing films of 2025, setting a new benchmark for theatrical anime releases.

With expectations running exceptionally high, supporters of the franchise are naturally anxious to learn when the sequel will arrive. Although studio Ufotable has maintained silence regarding an official launch schedule, recent industry discoveries have provided a fresh focal point for enthusiastic speculation.

The Sony Pictures and Crunchyroll September 2027 Listing

A recent schedule update from tracking platform The Numbers revealed that Sony Pictures, in collaboration with Crunchyroll, has reserved a slot for an untitled animated movie in September 2027. Because these two major entities serve as the global distributors for the franchise's cinematic projects, observers quickly connected the dots.

While the listing currently lacks an official title or specific identifying markers, the timeframe has immediately drawn the attention of the anime community. Many believe the placeholder could very well point toward the upcoming sequel.

Analyzing the Timeline and Production Windows

A potential mid-September 2027 premiere would fit comfortably within traditional production intervals for the franchise. Historically, the gap between animated seasons since the debut in 2019 has generally spanned between one and one and a half years.

Looking at the immediate predecessor, Infinity Castle Part 1 debuted in Japan on July 18, 2025, before arriving in North America two months later on September 12, 2025. A two-year gap leading to late 2027 would grant Ufotable sufficient time to maintain their celebrated animation standards without rushing the production process.

Fan Reactions and Alternative Possibilities

Despite the excitement surrounding the mysterious calendar entry, nothing has been formally confirmed by the studios. Fans remain divided on whether the September 2027 slot genuinely belongs to the epic fantasy adventure or another major property entirely.

Another strong contender for a 2027 theatrical slot is Solo Leveling: Beyond the System, which was officially announced during the Crunchyroll Showcase at Anime Expo on July 3, 2026. Given that both properties have major films on the horizon, audiences acknowledge that the mystery project might highlight an entirely different franchise.

Upcoming Announcement Expectations at Jump Festa

Hopes for an official confirmation rest heavily on upcoming industry events. Many followers anticipate that definitive news regarding the timeline will finally be unveiled during Jump Festa 2027, scheduled for December 19 and 20, 2026.

Until that convention arrives, the calendar entry remains purely speculative. Viewers must exercise patience as they wait for the production teams to disclose their official plans for the continuation.

Franchise Legacy and Expectations

As the narrative nears its ultimate conclusion through this massive trilogy, the pressure on the creative team is immense. The first installment proved that theatrical anime can achieve unprecedented global financial heights.

Regardless of whether the mysterious distributor listing refers to this specific sequel or another blockbuster adaptation, the community remains confident that the final product will deliver an extraordinary visual and emotional spectacle.

ld.articleBody:
Top Honors for 'Ah Girl'

The 37th edition of the Singapore International Film Festival concluded its run at the Singtel Waterfront Theatre, celebrating the finest achievements in Asian and international cinema. At the heart of the ceremony was the Asian Feature Film Competition, which crowned Ang Geck Geck Priscilla's debut feature 'Ah Girl' as the best film.

Set against the backdrop of 1990s Singapore, the winning drama centers on a seven-year-old girl navigating life after the separation of her parents. The project's journey to the top has been long and deliberate, having been developed at the festival's Southeast Asian Film Lab in 2015 before securing additional recognition on the international circuit.

Directorial Acclaim for Shahrbanoo Sadat

In the directing category, filmmaker Shahrbanoo Sadat took home the prize for her feature 'No Good Men'. The drama, which previously served as the opening film at the Berlinale, is set in Kabul just before the return of the Taliban to power.

The narrative follows a cameraman whose professional aspirations, family ties, and personal freedoms are abruptly thrown into uncertainty. Sadat, who relocated to Germany, has built a notable filmography that includes previous premieres at Cannes.

Recognizing Acting Excellence and Jury Favorites

The jury opted to split the best performance prize between two distinctive talents. Pushpa Thing Lama received recognition for her role in 'Elephants in the Fog', a story following a member of Nepal's Kinnar community in search of her missing daughter.

Sharing the award was Putri Marino for her work in 'Four Seasons in Java', a magical realist tale about a woman returning to her hometown after spending two decades behind bars. Meanwhile, Japanese director Nagahisa Makoto was awarded the Special Jury Prize for his sophomore feature, 'Burn'.

Southeast Asian Shorts and Special Mentions

The festival also shone a spotlight on short-form cinema through the Southeast Asian Short Film Competition. Yogyakarta-based artist Arief Budiman was named best Southeast Asian short film director for 'Golden Island', which explores a collaborative filmmaking process between two videographers from Java and Papua.

Additional short film winners included Ratchapoom Boonbunchachoke for 'The Bovine Comedy', Berthold Wahjudi for his Special Jury Prize win, and Sarah Lingam, who claimed the best performance prize for 'Flame of the Forest'. The honor for best Singapore short film went to Exyl for 'Singapore God'.

Audience Choices and Industry Pitching Forums

Festival audiences cast their votes for the Audience Choice Award, which went to the Singapore Panorama Programme package titled 'Second Life, Second Skin'. This collection features five distinct short films directed by Shara Tay, Ash Goh Hua, Syahmi Iman, Leon Cheo, and Ewan Leong.

Industry professionals also gathered for the SGIFF Pro Pitching Forum, where several projects secured development support. Among the recipients were Yamaguchi Shin and Miyahara Takuya, Lệ Diễm Hà, Tong Khoon Mun, Zhou Ke Xin, and the duo Sam Chua Weishi and Rein Maychaelson.

Special Tributes to Cinema Icons

Beyond the competitive categories, the festival took time to honor established cinematic figures. Indian star Aamir Khan was presented with the SGIFF Screen Icon Award by Peter Chan during a special conversation session.

Additionally, Japanese auteur Kore-eda Hirokazu received the SGIFF Cinema Honorary Award from Boo Junfeng, recognizing a prolific year that included the release of two features.

ld.articleBody:
A Landmark Distribution Agreement

Shraddha Kapoor's forthcoming biographical drama Eetha has generated significant trade buzz by reportedly locking in a major theatrical distribution deal. PVR INOX Pictures has acquired the all-India domestic theatrical rights for a substantial 90 crore.

This agreement is structured on an advance basis and comes together just a month prior to the film's scheduled theatrical premiere. Such a high-value pre-release commitment underscores the strong commercial confidence that exhibitors have in the project's box office potential.

Setting a Benchmark for Female-Led Cinema

The reported 90 crore agreement places Eetha among the most notable pre-release distribution deals ever achieved by an Indian female-led Hindi film. Industry observers have drawn comparisons to Alia Bhatt's Gangubai Kathiawadi, highlighting the heavy commercial expectations carried by Kapoor's new project.

This development is particularly striking because Eetha diverges from conventional commercial entertainers, focusing instead on a biographical narrative rooted deeply in Maharashtra's traditional Tamasha and Lavani cultural landscape.

A Proven Creative Partnership

For Shraddha Kapoor, this milestone follows the extraordinary success of Stree 2, which established itself as one of the biggest Hindi blockbusters of 2024. Her involvement adds immense star power and audience draw to the upcoming biographical feature.

Director Laxman Utekar brings additional commercial credibility to the table, having previously directed Vicky Kaushal in the blockbuster Chhaava. With both Stree 2 and Chhaava having crossed the 500 crore mark at the Indian box office, the actress-director duo commands widespread industry trust.

Cultural Roots and Narrative Inspiration

Rather than functioning as a direct biopic, Eetha draws inspiration from the life of legendary Lavani performer Vithabai Bhau Mang Narayangaonkar and various accounts documented in a book about her life. The narrative explores the personal struggles, sacrifices, and resilience of traditional artists.

The filmmakers organized dedicated workshops with experienced Lavani performers to ensure authentic representation of the traditional dance form. Shraddha Kapoor even suffered a muscle tear during training for a demanding dance sequence, reflecting the intense physical and artistic commitment poured into the central role.

Regional Strengths and Musical Appeal

The regional connection to Maharashtra's cultural heritage is expected to give Eetha a robust foundational audience in the state. At the same time, its emotional core aims to strike a chord with viewers on a wider national scale.

Music serves as another major pillar for the film, with the acclaimed duo Ajay-Atul composing the soundtrack. Given their deep ties to traditional Marathi musical arrangements, the public reception of the songs will likely play a crucial role in building pre-release anticipation.

Cast, Crew, and Release Details

Produced under Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations by Dinesh Vijan, Laxman Utekar, and Karishma Sharma, Eetha boasts a robust supporting ensemble. The movie features Randeep Hooda, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, Siddharth Jadhav, Anant Joshi, and Nana Patekar.

With its theatrical rollout slated for December 4, 2026, the film arrives bearing high expectations. Its ultimate standing will depend heavily on its ability to transcend regional boundaries and sustain strong word-of-mouth momentum after release.

The upcoming biographical drama Eetha, starring Shraddha Kapoor and directed by Laxman Utekar, has reportedly secured an all-India theatrical distribution deal worth 90 crore with PVR INOX Pictures.

Published 2 November 2026

A Landmark Distribution Agreement

Shraddha Kapoor's forthcoming biographical drama Eetha has generated significant trade buzz by reportedly locking in a major theatrical distribution deal. PVR INOX Pictures has acquired the all-India domestic theatrical rights for a substantial 90 crore.

This agreement is structured on an advance basis and comes together just a month prior to the film's scheduled theatrical premiere. Such a high-value pre-release commitment underscores the strong commercial confidence that exhibitors have in the project's box office potential.

Setting a Benchmark for Female-Led Cinema

The reported 90 crore agreement places Eetha among the most notable pre-release distribution deals ever achieved by an Indian female-led Hindi film. Industry observers have drawn comparisons to Alia Bhatt's Gangubai Kathiawadi, highlighting the heavy commercial expectations carried by Kapoor's new project.

This development is particularly striking because Eetha diverges from conventional commercial entertainers, focusing instead on a biographical narrative rooted deeply in Maharashtra's traditional Tamasha and Lavani cultural landscape.

A Proven Creative Partnership

For Shraddha Kapoor, this milestone follows the extraordinary success of Stree 2, which established itself as one of the biggest Hindi blockbusters of 2024. Her involvement adds immense star power and audience draw to the upcoming biographical feature.

Director Laxman Utekar brings additional commercial credibility to the table, having previously directed Vicky Kaushal in the blockbuster Chhaava. With both Stree 2 and Chhaava having crossed the 500 crore mark at the Indian box office, the actress-director duo commands widespread industry trust.

Cultural Roots and Narrative Inspiration

Rather than functioning as a direct biopic, Eetha draws inspiration from the life of legendary Lavani performer Vithabai Bhau Mang Narayangaonkar and various accounts documented in a book about her life. The narrative explores the personal struggles, sacrifices, and resilience of traditional artists.

The filmmakers organized dedicated workshops with experienced Lavani performers to ensure authentic representation of the traditional dance form. Shraddha Kapoor even suffered a muscle tear during training for a demanding dance sequence, reflecting the intense physical and artistic commitment poured into the central role.

Regional Strengths and Musical Appeal

The regional connection to Maharashtra's cultural heritage is expected to give Eetha a robust foundational audience in the state. At the same time, its emotional core aims to strike a chord with viewers on a wider national scale.

Music serves as another major pillar for the film, with the acclaimed duo Ajay-Atul composing the soundtrack. Given their deep ties to traditional Marathi musical arrangements, the public reception of the songs will likely play a crucial role in building pre-release anticipation.

Cast, Crew, and Release Details

Produced under Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations by Dinesh Vijan, Laxman Utekar, and Karishma Sharma, Eetha boasts a robust supporting ensemble. The movie features Randeep Hooda, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, Siddharth Jadhav, Anant Joshi, and Nana Patekar.

With its theatrical rollout slated for December 4, 2026, the film arrives bearing high expectations. Its ultimate standing will depend heavily on its ability to transcend regional boundaries and sustain strong word-of-mouth momentum after release.

The Graham Norton Show Remark

A recent appearance by Michael Douglas on a talk show program has sparked renewed discussions surrounding a decades-old Academy Awards race. While talking alongside his fellow nominee, Douglas openly questioned the outcome of the 1988 best actress category.

The actor expressed his belief that his Fatal Attraction co-star should have taken home the prize instead of the eventual winner. His candid on-air comments quickly gained attention across digital platforms.

Cher's Graceful Response

Despite the viral nature of the critical remark, the targeted star chose to handle the situation with complete poise. A representative speaking on behalf of the legendary entertainer made her stance clear to the public.

The spokesperson offered a simple yet definitive statement to address any friction, noting that the music and acting icon holds genuine fondness for the actor who voiced the critique.

The 1988 Academy Awards Context

The historic clash took place at the 60th Academy Awards held in April 1988. On that night, Cher emerged victorious in the best actress category for her work in the romantic comedy Moonstruck.

That particular film earned widespread recognition from the Academy, securing a total of six nominations. Alongside the leading performance win, the project also triumphed in categories for adapted screenplay and supporting actress.

Glenn Close's Nomination Journey

The conversation on the talk show heavily centered around Glenn Close and her long history with the Academy. When Douglas brought up the topic, he reminded viewers that she had already accumulated multiple nominations by that point in her career.

Fatal Attraction marked the first time Close was recognized in the best actress category, following three prior nods as a supporting actress for different films. Though she did not win that evening, she has continued to earn recognition from the Academy over the years.

Room for Playful Interruption

The studio audience reacted with amusement when the critical remark was made during the broadcast. Recognizing the playful tension of the moment, Close herself stepped in to temper her co-star's comments.

Turning directly toward Douglas on stage, she urged him to soften his stance with a lighthearted plea for kindness. The interaction added a touch of warmth to the retrospective debate over the classic 1980s film race.

A Historic Night for Multiple Nominees

Both Moonstruck and Fatal Attraction shared a heavy presence at the 1988 ceremony, each securing six nominations overall. The two titles went head-to-head in major races including best picture and best director.

Ultimately, those top competitive fields were won by Bernardo Bertolucci and his epic feature, The Last Emperor. Meanwhile, Michael Douglas found personal success that same night by winning best actor for his performance in Oliver Stone's Wall Street.

Michael Douglas publicly stated on a talk show that Glenn Close should have won the 1988 best actress Oscar instead of Cher for Moonstruck. A representative for Cher responded by stating that the icon adores Michael Douglas, while Close playfully urged her co-star to be kind during the broadcast.

ld.articleBody:
Grand Opening Projections and Scale

The highly anticipated cinematic adaptation of Ramayana is gearing up for its theatrical debut on Thursday. Industry experts project that the large-scale mythological venture will pull in between Rs 75 crore and Rs 100 crore across various languages on its opening day alone.

With a story deeply rooted in India's cultural consciousness, insiders believe the movie possesses the raw potential to scale lifetime collections anywhere from Rs 1,000 crore to an astonishing Rs 3,000 crore, provided it deeply resonates with the viewing public.

A Star-Studded Cast and Crew

The film features a prominent principal cast, starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi portraying Goddess Sita, and Yash stepping into the role of Ravana. Behind the camera, the project is directed by Nitesh Tiwari, widely known for his work on Dangal and Chhichhore.

Additionally, the film boasts high-profile technical backing, including music composition by A R Rahman and Hans Zimmer, visual effects crafted by the Oscar-winning company DNEG, and production handled jointly by Namit Malhotra and Yash.

Faith-Based Cinema and Critical Proofing

Exhibitors have pointed out that Ramayana transcends conventional critical standards because a vast segment of the audience will experience it through devotion and reverence. Prominent exhibitor Vishek Chauhan emphasized that this release belongs to a distinct genre of faith-based cinema centered on Lord Rama.

Because it taps directly into religious sentiment and the country's biggest deity, industry insiders suggest the feature is largely critic-proof. If the spiritual connection hits home with the Hindu devotee base, exhibitors believe its theatrical run could shatter numerous records.

Multiplex Chains and Advance Bookings

Major cinema operators are preparing for a massive turnout, with Cinepolis India reporting advance sales of over one lakh tickets and scheduling more than 1,600 shows for the opening day. Miraj Entertainment has designated 225 screens with 960 daily shows across Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, and Tamil languages.

Demand is particularly robust in Delhi-NCR, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka, while Tier-2 markets are outperforming early expectations. Furthermore, ticketing trends indicate strong traction for premium formats like IMAX and 3D, with entry-level prices starting around Rs 200.

Navigating the Festive Holiday Calendar

The release window coincides directly with major festive celebrations, presenting a unique calendar challenge. Friday marks Dhanteras, followed by Choti Diwali on Saturday and Diwali on Sunday, which may temporarily pull families toward home pujas or evening celebrations.

Exhibitors note that while the opening weekend might see slight fluctuations due to holiday festivities, the true test of momentum will arrive when the proper work week begins on Monday, supported by word of mouth and repeat family viewings.

Regional Dynamics in Southern Markets

While the buzz in Karnataka is particularly elevated due to Yash's massive popularity, the overall sentiment in southern markets remains measured. Trade experts attribute this moderate excitement to simultaneous regional releases, such as Suriya's Scene and Nayanthara's Mookuthi Amman 2.

Analysts estimate that Ramayana will pull in approximately Rs 30 crore to Rs 40 crore from the southern circuit, noting that mythological storytelling operates differently in comparison to high-octane pan-Indian mass action entertainers.

News Overview

Ramayana is set to debut in theatres on Thursday with expected opening day collections between Rs 75 crore and Rs 100 crore, while experts project lifetime earnings could reach up to Rs 3,000 crore. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, and its box office trajectory will heavily depend on audience resonance and faith-based turnout during the festive Diwali weekend.

Sunny Deol Reviews Ramayana

Bollywood actor Sunny Deol, who portrays Lord Hanuman in the ambitious cinematic adaptation Ramayana, recently watched the movie and shared his thoughts with fans. Through a video published on his Instagram account, the actor expressed immense admiration for the project and strongly recommended it to the public.

The actor stated that the film exceeded his expectations and insisted that every Indian should experience the epic on the big screen. His enthusiastic review follows the theatrical release of the movie, which stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi in prominent roles.

Praise for Hollywood-Level VFX

A major highlight of Sunny Deol's review was his high praise for the film's visual effects and technical execution. He remarked that the movie easily surpasses Hollywood standards in terms of computer-generated imagery and world-building.

He explained that the visual quality successfully transports viewers directly into the ancient mythical era without ever feeling artificial. According to the actor, the immersive environment makes audiences feel as though they are physically present in that universe.

A Personal Plea to Viewers

Rather than just making a standard promotional request, Sunny Deol addressed his followers with a deep sense of personal appeal. He playfully asserted that he was not merely requesting, but rather claiming his right to ask them to watch the movie because of its exceptional quality.

He commended the entire cast for delivering stellar performances across the board. The actor ended his message with a resonant exclamation of 'Jai Shri Ram', echoing the devotional theme of the venture.

The Hanuman Reveal and Part Two

In Ramayana, Sunny Deol takes on the divine role of Pawanputra Hanuman, though his appearance in the first installment is kept deliberately brief. Viewers get a glimpse of his colossal form accompanied by the Hanuman Chalisa as the first part concludes.

To maintain audience intrigue for the sequel, filmmakers chose to conceal his face during this initial appearance. The second part of Ramayana is slated for release on Diwali 2028, promising a deeper exploration of the narrative involving Hanuman and the intense battle against Ravana.

Cast, Direction, and Production

The mythological drama features a star-studded ensemble cast, including Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi. Their collective performances have contributed to the positive reception and steady theatrical performance of the movie.

Behind the scenes, the project is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra. Their collaborative vision has brought the epic tale to the silver screen, generating immense anticipation for the upcoming chapters.

Initial Box Office Reception

The cinematic adaptation opened in cinemas to a solid and expected response on its first day. Although the opening figures were steady, the word-of-mouth momentum and positive reviews helped sustain the box office run over the subsequent days.

With favorable audience reactions and endorsements from cast members like Sunny Deol, the film continues to draw crowds to theaters as it establishes its presence at the box office.

A Memorable Offer on Weekend Ka Vaar

Bollywood superstar Salman Khan recently made headlines by offering a promising musical opportunity to contestant Qazi Touqeer. During a recent Weekend Ka Vaar episode of the hit reality television show Bigg Boss 20, Salman praised the contestant's entertaining persona and vocal abilities directly on air.

Impressed by his ongoing journey inside the house, the host explicitly told Qazi that he would provide him with a song once the reality series concludes. This unexpected gesture instantly brought immense joy and gratitude to the aspiring singer, leaving viewers and fans excited about his future prospects in the music industry.

Qazi Touqeer's Journey in Bigg Boss 20

Kashmiri singer Qazi Touqeer has been capturing widespread attention ever since he stepped into the famous house of Bigg Boss 20. Week after week, he continues to showcase his natural flair for audience engagement, his distinctive rockstar persona, and a strong willingness to dive into every activity.

While his unique antics and smooth interpersonal skills have kept viewers thoroughly entertained, it is his raw musical talent that has truly stood out as a major talking point throughout the current season.

Early Beginnings and Fame Gurukul

Qazi's passion for music is far from recent, dating all the way back to his early days in the entertainment industry. In 2005, he competed alongside his close friend Arijit Singh as a young contestant on the popular singing reality show Fame Gurukul.

Ultimately, Qazi emerged as the winner of that particular competition, while Arijit Singh finished in sixth place. Despite their differing paths afterward—with Arijit rising to become one of the nation's biggest playback voices—the two have maintained a supportive bond without any negative feelings.

Praise From Industry Heavyweights

Salman Khan is not the only notable industry figure who has taken notice of Qazi's captivating stage presence. Filmmaker Rohit Shetty also visited the reality show as a guest host and left deeply impressed by the singer's overall charisma.

During his appearance, Shetty highlighted how a growing number of viewers are turning into massive fans of the contestant. The director even hinted at a potential collaboration, promising a track if he ever directs a film featuring a romantic song.

Uncertainty Over Future Projects

Following Salman Khan's public promise on the show, fans have been speculating about the nature of the upcoming musical project. It remains entirely unconfirmed whether the offered track will form part of a film's official soundtrack or release as an independent single.

Regardless of the format, the endorsement from two major industry veterans marks a significant turning point in Qazi's career trajectory, revitalizing the spotlight on his musical aspirations.

ld.articleBody:
The Crossover Announcement

Fans of the CBS crime drama lineup are receiving a special treat as actor Jeremy Sisto crosses over to the network's spinoff series CIA. The 52-year-old television star, known for portraying Assistant Special Agent in Charge Jubal Valentine on FBI, is bringing his established persona directly into the sister show.

The network has confirmed that this special television event extends beyond a single evening. Sisto is slated for a two-episode guest arc, allowing audiences to watch the character navigate investigations across both Monday night programs.

Episode Details and Dates

The first of the two scheduled appearances takes place on November 9 in an episode titled 'Legacy'. In this installment, airing at 9 p.m. ET/PT on CBS, the characters investigate a deadly explosion on Manhattan’s Upper East Side that kills an international arms dealer. The plot centers on tracking an assassin named Felix Vincente while character Bill Goodman faces a tough decision.

Sisto returns for the following week's broadcast titled 'Inside Men', scheduled for November 16 at the same time slot. That narrative follows Bill and Colin as they go undercover to foil a plot involving a livestreamed violent attack, while Bill conceals a secret from Colin.

Status on FBI

Viewers worried about the actor's main television home can rest easy, as there are no announced plans for Sisto to exit FBI. He remains firmly part of the cast for Season 9, treating these network appearances strictly as special guest roles.

His presence on the spinoff highlights the shared fictional universe established by the network, assuring fans that his primary role on the Monday night drama is completely secure.

Previous Franchise Crossovers

This television event is part of a broader pattern of shared storytelling between the two popular CBS dramas. The interconnected world was previously highlighted during the October 5 season premieres.

During those broadcasts, Necar Zadegan appeared on FBI portraying CIA Deputy Chief of Station Nikki Reynard, while John Boyd brought his FBI character Stuart Scola over to CIA. Sisto also previously appeared in the original series premiere back in February.

Broadcast and Streaming Information

For audiences wanting to follow the narrative live, FBI airs on Mondays at 8 p.m. ET/PT on CBS, immediately preceding CIA at 9 p.m. ET/PT. Both programs are broadcast through local network affiliates.

Additionally, viewers can stream the episodes on Paramount+. Premium subscribers have access to live viewing through local affiliates, whereas Essential subscribers can stream the content on demand beginning the following day.

ld.articleBody:
Bullion Market Sees Renewed Consumer Interest

The domestic retail landscape has experienced a sudden surge in consumer participation following a sharp correction in bullion prices. With recent festive celebrations concluding and the traditional wedding season commencing, buyers who had previously paused their purchases due to high costs are returning to jewellery shops in large numbers.

Industry experts note that the unexpected drop in metal valuations has transformed the seasonal shopping outlook. Rather than delaying acquisitions, families are actively utilizing the current price window to secure ornaments for upcoming marital ceremonies.

Global Factors Drive Domestic Price Corrections

Because the nation heavily depends on international imports to satisfy its total bullion demand, external market dynamics have played a primary role in the recent price adjustments. Market participants explain that global economic shifts have carried far more weight in lowering rates than localized domestic trends.

Traders and proprietors emphasize that such a rapid and steep descent caught many in the trade by surprise, especially following the record highs observed around previous festive periods.

Retailers Highlight Attractive Entry Points

Mukesh Bhai, proprietor of Radhika Jewellers based in Rajkot, observed that previous valuations had soared to approximately Rs 1.50 lakh per 10 grams during last year's Diwali period. In contrast, those same categories have now retreated to nearly Rs 1.15 lakh per 10 grams, presenting an enticing opportunity for households planning nuptials in January and February.

Commenting on future market trajectories, Bhai suggested that the precious metal is nearing its lower boundary. He noted that while a minor additional dip of 2 to 5 percent remains possible, the potential for any severe downward correction is now quite restricted.

Silver And Other Precious Metals Adjust

Alongside the movements in gold, silver has also experienced significant shifts following an extended rally. Industry observers indicate that silver has largely retraced back to the valuation levels witnessed roughly a year ago.

Professionals in the trade view this correction as a natural cooling-off period after an aggressive upward sprint, leaving silver in a sound position for future upward momentum.

Relief For Families Shopping For Occasions

Everyday retail shoppers have welcomed the financial relief provided by the declining rates. Seema Joshi, actively shopping for her son's wedding ceremony, expressed gratitude for the timely market correction.

She noted that reduced ornament prices significantly alleviate the economic pressure on households managing major seasonal expenses, potentially inspiring even greater consumer activity if these favorable rates persist.

Monetary Policy And Global Pressures

Underlying the retail changes are broader macroeconomic influences, including market expectations surrounding upcoming US Federal Reserve monetary policies in December. Because bullion generates no direct interest yield, investors frequently reallocate capital toward alternative assets featuring lower opportunity costs.

Simultaneously, the US dollar has strengthened significantly, approaching a 19-month peak. Because gold is globally valued in dollars, this strength elevates purchasing costs for buyers utilizing other currencies, naturally dampening international demand and triggering a domestic correction.

Geopolitical Conflicts And Current Rates

Ongoing geopolitical tensions near the Strait of Hormuz continue to provoke anxiety regarding potential supply chain interruptions, subsequently driving up crude oil valuations. This dynamic stokes inflation fears and increases the likelihood of further international interest rate hikes.

Within the domestic market, current gold valuations stand at Rs 12,557 per gram for 24-carat purity. Meanwhile, pricing for 22-carat and 18-carat gold categories rests at Rs 11,510 per gram and Rs 9,418 per gram, respectively.

Driven by global economic shifts, stronger US currency trends, and international monetary expectations, the reduced metal valuations have provided much-needed financial relief to families preparing for upcoming celebrations.

The Dunesday Showdown

A major box office showdown is shaping up for the winter holiday season, widely dubbed by industry observers as 'Dunesday'. Two of the most anticipated Hollywood blockbusters are scheduled to hit theater screens simultaneously, setting the stage for an unprecedented weekend of ticket sales.

Both films are slated to arrive on December 18, bringing two entirely different fanbases and cinematic universes into direct competition. Studios and analysts are closely monitoring early numbers to gauge how this high-profile face-off will impact overall theatrical revenues.

Avengers: Doomsday Tracking Projections

Marvel Studios' upcoming superhero epic is currently projected to pull in an impressive $270 million domestically during its opening weekend, according to early figures from NRG. If these estimates hold steady, the blockbuster could shatter existing December box office records.

The current record-holder for a December release is Spider-Man: No Way Home, which brought in $260 million back in 2021. Industry trackers note that Doomsday is positioned to eclipse that milestone, trailing only massive historical openings like Avengers: Endgame and Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

Creative Team and Star-Studded Cast

The creative helm for Avengers: Doomsday sees the return of directors Anthony and Joe Russo following their monumental success with Avengers: Endgame. The screenplay is penned by Michael Waldron and Stephen McFeely, tasked with weaving together numerous heroes from across timelines and generations.

A major highlight of the upcoming Marvel feature is the unexpected casting of Robert Downey Jr., who returns to the franchise not as Tony Stark or Iron Man, but as the iconic villain Doctor Doom. The ensemble cast features a myriad of familiar faces ready for a massive holiday confrontation.

Dune: Part Three Expectations

On the opposing side of the December 18 marquee, Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three is tracking toward a very healthy opening weekend between $75 million and $80 million. The director's sweeping visual style continues to draw strong pre-release interest from sci-fi enthusiasts.

Despite sharing a release date with a powerhouse Marvel title, industry insiders remain optimistic about the broader holiday theatrical window. The extended festive period is expected to provide enough breathing room for multiple major releases to sustain their momentum.

Returning Talent in Arrakis

Denis Villeneuve returns to direct the continuation of the epic sci-fi saga, bringing back a star-studded principal cast. The film features performances by Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Florence Pugh, Anya Taylor-Joy, Jason Momoa, and Robert Pattinson.

With such a recognizable ensemble and the established popularity of the franchise's cinematic universe, the feature is expected to be a dominant force on the theatrical circuit throughout the holiday season.

A Historic Weekend for Hollywood

The simultaneous arrival of two distinct tentpole films marks a monumental moment for the Hollywood exhibition calendar. Because the titles cater to divergent audience demographics, the dual release format could maximize total box office potential rather than cannibalizing ticket sales.

As the mid-December release date approaches, stakeholders across the industry will continue to analyze tracking figures to see if this holiday weekend cements itself as one of the most lucrative box office events in recent memory.

Celebrating Six Decades of Science Fiction History

The year 2026 marks the sixtieth anniversary of the broader science fiction franchise, honoring six decades of culturally significant storytelling. Since the broadcast of the initial television program featuring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy alongside countless subsequent films and television spin-offs, the universe has forged a monumental legacy.

While numerous iterations achieved widespread acclaim, certain entries experienced more polarized receptions from audiences. Despite mixed views, the extensive history continues to resonate deeply with passionate followers across generations.

Revisiting The Final Frontier Legacy

Among the more controversial motion picture chapters is the 1989 feature Star Trek V: The Final Frontier, which centered on the original Enterprise crew. Directed by Shatner himself, the narrative followed Captain Kirk, Spock, and Dr. McCoy as they ventured toward the center of the galaxy.

Though the film faced mixed critical responses upon its initial debut, it remains a notable milestone for enthusiasts of the classic ensemble. Now, nearly four decades later, the franchise moniker returns in a brand new interactive format.

Bringing New Civilizations to the Tabletop

Star Trek Ascendancy: The Final Frontier is an upcoming expansion designed for Gale Force Nine's strategic 4X tabletop game. While borrowing its title from the classic cinematic release, the expansion functions as an independent gameplay addition rather than a direct narrative adaptation.

The tabletop expansion introduces three playable civilizations previously restricted to crowdfunding backers on Gamefound. These factions include the Gorn, the Tholians, and the Terran Empire hailing from the alternate Mirror Universe.

New Campaign Modes and Automated Opponents

Beyond faction additions, the product introduces innovative ways to experience matches. A dedicated Campaign Mode delivers scenario-based objectives designed to enhance replayability far beyond traditional skirmishes.

Furthermore, non-player civilizations offer automated opponents, allowing enthusiasts to engage in solo matches or integrate computer-controlled factions into multiplayer gaming sessions.

Extensive Physical Components and Storage Solutions

The physical release ships packed with a massive array of components. Contents include ninety plastic miniature ships, forty-five system disks, thirteen dice, and upwards of four hundred cards.

Additional elements feature resource tokens, fleet markers, revised rulebooks, and a dedicated campaign book. Everything is packaged alongside a custom storage solution meant to accommodate the extensive collection.

Production Updates and Pricing Details

Originally launched in 2016, the core strategy board game has received multiple expansions over the years. The upcoming release represents one of the most ambitious undertakings for the platform to date.

Pre-orders are currently hosted via Zatu Games with an approximate listing price of one hundred thirty-eight US dollars. Additional bundles are available for newcomers seeking core civilizations or past expansions.

Fulfillment and Crowdfunding Background

The project initially found success through crowdfunding on Gamefound, securing over three million dollars in financial backing. Although encountering preliminary delays, updates from October 2026 confirmed production was nearing completion.

Shipping to distribution hubs is anticipated shortly, with final fulfillment expected in late 2026, though a definitive retail release date remains unconfirmed.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction and Opening Figures

The highly anticipated cinematic venture Ramayana has officially commenced its box office journey worldwide, arriving on screens ahead of Diwali on November 5, 2026. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and co-produced by Namit Malhotra, the feature carries the distinction of being the most expensive project in the history of Indian cinema. Despite boasting a massive budget, a Hollywood studio partnership, extensive Western promotions, and a historic international screen count, the opening numbers have fallen short of initial expectations.

On its first day of release, the film accumulated a global gross of ₹ 127.50 crore. While crossing the hundred-crore mark on opening day is a notable feat for any release, these returns do not align with the colossal scale, ambition, and financial investment behind the mounting of the feature. Projections had previously anticipated a global opening closer to ₹ 160 crore, making the actual global haul a sobering start for the makers.

Domestic Performance and Regional Response

Within the domestic market, Ramayana secured a solid initial foothold, pulling in ₹ 64.85 crore in net collections, which translates to ₹ 77.50 crore in gross earnings. Positive audience reactions and favorable reviews greeted the movie upon its Thursday debut. However, this critical reception failed to translate into overwhelming footfall momentum across all regions, particularly in specific regional markets.

A particularly striking underperformance was noted in the Kannada version of the film, which netted merely ₹ 7.50 crore. This figure represents just one-third of the opening day numbers achieved by actor Yash in his previous cinematic outings, namely KGF Chapter 2 and Toxic. Consequently, the reliance on strong word of mouth becomes crucial for sustaining ticket sales and driving growth over the extended four-day Diwali weekend.

International Distribution and Overseas Earnings

International distribution was handled by Sony Pictures, securing an unprecedented release across 70,000 screens globally. This footprint was roughly triple the screen count of any previous Indian film release. Yet, the overseas haul for the first day remained under $5.5 million, with North American paid previews contributing $1.5 million to that total.

While a sub-$10 million international start might ordinarily be considered respectable for standard Bollywood or regional releases, the sheer scale of Ramayana renders these figures underwhelming. The disparity between the unprecedented screen distribution and the actual ticket sales abroad has raised questions among trade analysts regarding international audience uptake.

Leaderboard Comparison and Adipurush Benchmark

On the broader Indian cinema leaderboard, Ramayana settled for the 16th biggest opening of all time. Its ₹ 127.50-crore start places it behind Jawan, which earned ₹ 129 crore, and surprisingly, even behind Adipurush. Failing to surpass Dhurandhar 2, which recorded a ₹ 202-crore start, further highlighted the film's shortfall against contemporary box-office titans.

The comparison with Adipurush has drawn considerable commentary, given that the earlier Prabhas-led adaptation faced severe criticism and derision upon its release. Despite that negative reception, Adipurush managed to secure higher gross earnings and superior footfalls on its opening day than the newly released Ramayana.

Cast, Crew, and Production Background

Ramayana has been conceptualized as a sweeping two-part epic. The production duties are spearheaded by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios, working alongside DNEG and Yash’s banner, Monster Mind Creations. The narrative is brought to life by a prominent ensemble cast featuring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash in the role of Ravana.

Supporting the principal cast are Ravie Dubey as Lakshman and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. Following the worldwide premiere of the first installment on November 5, 2026, the second part of the epic is currently scheduled for release during the Diwali holiday season in 2028.

The film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, and is produced as a two-part epic by Namit Malhotra.

With domestic net earnings at ₹ 64.85 crore and a lower-than-expected overseas and regional turnout, the movie now relies on positive word of mouth for its extended weekend.
